head: 220e00d

findings.what: Agentic --native-only can still ship the shredded text as chart_asset SUCCESS, bypassing the claimed fail-closed floor.
findings.why: _winning_page_output returns any passing non-native best_output before evaluating native_rotated_text_shredded. Under --native-only, _is_native_eligible_without_ocr returns True before needs_ocr_enhancement, the figure fixture enters the chart-asset lane, and its chart_asset SUCCESS contains the shredded native prose plus PNG. I reproduced this by running the PR's shipping test with native_only=True: it failed because sidecar status was success, engine chart_asset, and the shipped text began 'Figur\ne\n 4: Co...'. This directly defeats the stated reason for removing the attempts gate: --native-only still ships confetti as SUCCESS.

what_i_tried_to_break: I inspected both rotation branches and the page-derived geometry, searched for multiset/decimal correctness oracles, confirmed no existing test changed, ran the isolation canary and 18 focused branch tests (all passed), ran 31 broader rotation tests (all passed), physically verified shredded_rotated_page_p1.png is written in the ordinary rejecting-ladder case, and copied the new test into a detached 8ad92e1 worktree: exactly the detector and shipped-output behavioral assertions failed while the other eight passed. I then changed only the test config to native_only=True; the shipping regression failed, proving a passing chart_asset output short-circuits the floor. I found no second false positive in available fixtures. The no-table scope is a legitimate predicate limit, not a re-narrowing: rotated+table is already unconditionally refused by GH-147, and applying this geometry predicate to table cells would be overbroad.
